author: Leila Gharani
description:
🔥 Create charts that wow your audience. Learn the secrets now, start today! 👉 https://link.xelplus.com/yt-bizcharts-course

Still using a pie chart for lots of categories? Even if your boss asks for a pie chart, there’s a better option in Excel.

⬇️ DOWNLOAD the workbook here: https://pages.xelplus.com/better-pie-charts

In this video, you’ll learn how to build a clean, professional bar chart that’s better than a pie chart, while keeping all the same info people love about pies (including percent of total). You’ll also make it auto-update and auto-sort with a simple formula setup, so your chart stays readable even when the data changes.
